entity_relationships.base: manufacture and sell as its own
entity_relationships.third_person: manufactures and sells as its own
entity_relationships.gerund: manufacturing and selling as its own

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it, without tripping any of the guards below:

rules.text: The record says something substantive about the candidate {{entity_noun}} — describing an activity, arrangement, or dealing that involves it — rather than only naming it, listing it, or mentioning it in passing. Which party is involved is not this condition's subject; [SCR-2] decides that.

children.text: Involvement that is not making and selling does not satisfy this condition: a {{entity_noun}} only serviced, repaired, installed, tested, inspected, or certified, or used as an input, tool, or piece of equipment, is not one being manufactured and sold.

rules.text: It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the candidate {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

children.text: The manufacturer in question is NAMED at the top of the request; records may refer to it by that name, as "the manufacturer", or by any of its brands. Other companies may appear by name or by their standing. A brand, trade name, former name, division, plant, or business unit of the manufacturer IS the manufacturer itself. A statement about the manufacturer's parent company or a sister brand counts as one about the manufacturer itself, and does not fail this condition merely for being attributed to them — unless the record shows the activity belongs to that company alone and not to the manufacturer.

A verb that leaves the commercial arrangement unstated does not by itself show whether the manufacturer is the party that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} it. Where the record says only that the manufacturer deals in the thing, without fixing in what capacity, the arrangement has not been established.

The manufacturer is not the one making and selling it when items in the {{entity_noun}} are made to a customer's specification, design, drawing, formula, or brand, or produced for a client, OEM, or brand owner, or when another party is the maker and the manufacturer only purchases, sources, resells, distributes, or represents them.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate has no bearing on the record's other candidates:

rules.text: The manufacturer's making and selling of the candidate {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
